request.style: English, smooth jazz vocal, male baritone solo, upright bass, brushed drums, piano, saxophone, warm and reflective mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Blessed be the Lord my rock
He trains my hands for war
My fingers ready for battle
Faithful God my fortress

[Chorus]
My stronghold and my deliverer
My shield where I take refuge
He subdues the peoples under me
My rock in every need

[Verse]
What is man that you take note
The son of man you think of
Like a breath he fades away
His days a passing shadow

[Chorus]
My stronghold and my deliverer
My shield where I take refuge
He subdues the peoples under me
My rock in every need

[Bridge]
Bend your heavens and come down
Touch the mountains and they smoke
The Lord is my rock and stay
His truth is my own way

[Outro]
Blessed be the Lord my rock
Faithful God my fortress
